newsitem.title: USA: Corrected-Knight Ridder May operating revs.
newsitem.headline: Corrected-Knight Ridder May operating revs.

text.p: Knight Ridder Inc said Monday its operating revenue for May was up 4.7 percent compared with the same month last year and for the year-to-date.
A company spokeswoman said operating revenue rose a little more than $15 million for May and about $75 million for the year-to-date.
It said the comparisons exclude Knight-Ridder Financial, which was sold in July 1996, and four newspapers of Walt Disney Co which were acquired May 9.

It said the 1997 figures also exclude the Grand Forks Herald, which was damaged by flood and fire in mid-April. The effect was not material except in circulation revenue, which would have been flat rather than down had Grand Forks been included, it said.

The newspaper and business information services company said its newspaper division, excluding the Disney papers, had a good month in May, with operating revenue up 5.3 percent to $193.6 million compared with the same month last year and up 5.4 percent to $1.04 billion for the year-to-date, it said.
Circulation revenue was down 1.5 percent to $38.1 million for the month and down 0.6 percent to $213.2 million for the year-to date, it said.
